headline: Gold and US Dollar Dip as Oil Prices and Middle East Tensions Eyed
summary: Gold prices eased and the US dollar dipped as traders weighed renewed oil-driven inflation risks and awaited upcoming central bank meetings.
why: Gold and the US dollar are traditional safe-haven assets whose values fluctuate based on geopolitical tensions and interest rate expectations.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Rising energy-driven inflation expectations alter the near-term appeal of non-yielding precious metals.

why_moved: Shifting expectations around central bank rate paths and energy costs impact safe-haven demand for bullion and currency holdings.
